apiProtocolHelp.claude-code: Claude Code sends requests with the Anthropic Messages protocol (typically /v1/messages). Prefer Anthropic Messages. OpenAI-style base URLs or other protocols are not converted in this version and may fail.
apiProtocolHelp.codex: Codex primarily uses the OpenAI Responses protocol. Prefer Responses; Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages may not work if they do not match the tool.
apiProtocolHelp.gemini-cli: Gemini CLI uses the Gemini native API. Prefer the Gemini native option; other protocols may fail if they do not match the tool.
apiProtocolHelp.opencode: OpenCode can use several protocols depending on the upstream (Chat Completions, Responses, or Anthropic Messages). Pick the one the endpoint expects; Folkbench writes the config as-is without conversion.
apiProtocolHelp.default: The protocol must match what the tool and upstream endpoint expect. Selectable options follow what each tool can write; Folkbench writes the config as-is without conversion in this version.
apiProtocolHelp.openclaw: OpenClaw writes the selected API protocol into config (often OpenAI Completions). Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini native are available. Folkbench does not convert protocols in this version—match the upstream.
apiProtocolHelp.pi: Pi writes the selected API protocol into config. Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini native are available. Folkbench does not convert protocols in this version—match the upstream.
apiProtocolHelp.hermes: Hermes API modes map to Chat Completions, Responses (codex_responses), and Anthropic Messages. Pick what the upstream speaks; this version does not convert protocols and does not offer Bedrock.
apiProtocolHelp.grok-build: Grok Build is Responses-native. Responses, Chat Completions, and Anthropic Messages are available; non-native choices need a compatible upstream. This version does not run local routing conversion.
apiProtocolHelp.minimax-code: MiniMax Code supports Anthropic Messages, Chat Completions, and Responses. Pick what the upstream speaks; Folkbench does not convert protocols in this version.

form.providerIdHelp: The provider ID is the key written under the tool config (for example models.providers.<id> in OpenClaw / Pi, or custom_providers[].name / model.provider: custom:<id> in Hermes). Model refs look like id/model. Pick a preset (openai, anthropic, …) from the list or type your own. Use letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores—no spaces or slashes.
